title: Let a verdict record commit under any claim, and prove the close path end to end
goal: Two pre-flight defects of my own. (1) .agents/roadmap-verdicts/<VC-id>.json is task metadata exactly like .agents/tasks/, but only .agents/tasks/ is exempt from the claim scope check: every one of the 30 verification tasks would be refused when it commits its verdict, and would have to re-claim with an extra scope to say what it found. Exempt the verdict directory in both checkers, as the task records are, and prove it with a commit that adds a verdict under a claim that does not reserve it. (2) Nobody has exercised the close path for the acceptance shape the 30 tasks now use - a script with arguments (scripts/check-roadmap-verdict.py <VC-id>): the zero-evidence guard, the argv split and the cwd are all assumed. Cover it end to end, including the failing case keeping the task open.
